{{Quote|Commander, this is Bacta Team leader. We have a functioning docking gate on level six that shows evidence of recent use. And, sir, wait until you get a look at the landing zone.|Bacta Team leader|<ref name="LoE" />}}
'''Bacta Team leader''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] with the rank of [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] who took charge of [[Bacta Team]] during the [[Hunt for Darth Sidious|hunt]] for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]<ref name="LoE" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>
